[[Watchman (Edan II)|Watchman]] '''Whitley''' was a [[Police officer/Legends|law enforcement officer]] operating in [[Southview Village]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]]. Whitley upheld the village law, which forbade weapons within the settlement limits.
